title: Hypixel Tweaks
description: Adds Keybindings for your most used commands
body:
This Client Side Mod makes your Life on Hypixel Skyblock easier.
Tired of typing /warp home or /warp hub? I got you!

 

## Keybindings:

`H` -> `/warp hub`

`I` -> `/warp home`

`P` -> `/p warp`

`F` -> `/warpforge`

`CTRL+E` -> `/echest`

`NUM1` -> `/visit visit1`

`NUM2` -> `/visit visit2`

`NUM3` -> `/visit visit3`

`CTRL+S` -> `/sacks` (for opening sacks)
 

I am not responsible for any Bans on Hypixels Server.
